items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: I got a job there with Willie Paiso.

ctx.x: So many of them. Yeah. Did they play from sheet music? It's a big band. Well, yeah.

At that time, that was the goal, you know, to make these bands and playing the orchestration. So I played with them a good while until I got a regular job on the canal in London. It was the Alamo we had there. I got a job there with Willie Paiso. Where did they play there? What kind of music? Jitney. Feet music? Or was it a hand cell? No, no. No, just didn't have time to fool with no music because you pick up number one behind the other, nothing but chorus. And people get there and dance. A man come in the place…
I played a lot. I'll give my break, huh? Mm-hmm. Well, did you enjoy playing from the arrangements more or playing just head arrangements?
